title: Voltline: the summer sale drops June 24
preheaderText: Four days of price drops on phones, audio, and wearables. Mark the calendar and pick your storage tier.
heroImageAlt: A phone glowing on a dark stage under pink and cyan light
heroText: The biggest price cuts of the year land at midnight on the 24th. Phones, audio, wearables, all marked down. Set a reminder now so you do not miss the first-hour doorbusters.
event1Text: The deepest cuts, limited stock. First hour only, one per customer.
event2Text: Headphones, earbuds, and speakers up to forty percent off.
event3Text: Final markdowns on last-season models before they are gone.
productImageAlt: The Voltline Pulse music player, front view
productText: A pocket player built for the long walk. Twelve-hour battery, lossless audio, and a display you can read in full sun.
ctaText: Sale prices go live to list members one hour early. Join now and get the first-hour link straight to your inbox.
legalText: Voltline is a fictitious brand used as sample content in an open-source HTML email compatibility framework. See github.com/dcondrey/html-email for details.
